name: DREAM: Dialogue-Based Reading Comprehension Challenge
description: DREAM is an in-depth dialogue-based reading comprehension dataset consisting of 10,197 multiple-choice questions on 6,444 multi-turn dialogues extracted from English listening comprehension examinations.

source_references.title: DREAM: A Challenge Data Set and Models for Dialogue-Based Reading Comprehension
source_references.notes: Published in Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL 2019).

verification.notes: Verified against TACL 2019 publication (DOI: 10.1162/tacl_a_00264) and official dataset release. Total questions: 10,197 (train: 6,116, dev: 2,040, test: 2,041) across 6,444 dialogues.
